comparison.objective: Grate cheese while stabilizing a box grater, then leave a safe end state; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization plus repeated force-bearing strokes versus fine socket engagement, bounded torque, collar rotation and response-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Latest versions require at least 5 g-equivalent grated under at least 3 N valid downstrokes, with grater standing and tools released; candidate requires two safe carriage impacts.
comparison.reason: Both include contact-force control and iteration, but abrasion/grating is a materially different tested ability from damping commissioning.
